question: After correcting ambient-audio resets, should `talk.idleTimeoutS` apply to every configured macOS Talk session or only sessions activated by Voice Wake?
rationale: The runtime defect is mechanically repairable, but source evidence cannot determine the intended permanent API scope because the linked problem is Voice Wake-specific while the proposed public setting is general.

options.title: General opt-in setting
options.body: Keep the disabled-by-default field for every macOS Talk session after correcting its interaction semantics and clearly documenting platform scope.

options.title: Voice Wake-only timeout
options.body: Track activation provenance and apply idle auto-deactivation only when Voice Wake started Talk.

recommendation.title: General opt-in setting
recommendation.body: Keep the disabled-by-default field for every macOS Talk session after correcting its interaction semantics and clearly documenting platform scope.
